proposal.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in VMware vCenter Server 6.7 (before update 3f) allows an attacker to bypass authentication and create/modify accounts (including adding to Administrators) via LDAP-related requests, demonstrated by exploit code.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Apply the vendor's security advisory VMSA-2020-0006 and update vCenter Server 6.7 to the fixed version (update 3f or later). If patching is not immediately possible, restrict access to LDAP/port 389 from untrusted networks and review/create detection rules for unauthorized LDAP Add/Modify operations.

evidence_quotes.claim: Report title describes the issue as an authentication bypass
Exploit includes functionality to create user entries
Exploit includes functionality to modify group membership to Administrators
